2024-10-31 | #014  

Certificate 2.2 (EN 10204) delivery with FRM, FRM-NOC, SAV

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-014_Gas-filter-portfolio_1R0. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. The test report certificate 2.2 acc. EN 10204 is always delivered with the product. Up to now when ordering in batches of more than 1 unit, it was included only in 1 box marking this one with “CERTIFICATE” sign in the outside.

Starting on 2024-11-05, we’re changing this process and we’re including the certificate in every unit, so there’ll be no indication outside of the box. This change will start and is applicable to the new orders. Open orders already placed will be delivered with the old method.

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-014_Gas-filter-portfolio_1R0. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. This information does not affect when ordering a 3.1 certificate, which is always 1 certificate per unit in the product box.

2024-10-31 | #014  

Updated data sheet for Gas and air filters

We’re pleased to announce the release of a revised data sheet for our gas and air filters. The new data sheet complies with a new format that we intend to use for all revised and new data sheets for DUNGS products. Important information such as dimensions and flow curves have been added.

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-014_Gas-filter-portfolio_1R0. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. The new data sheet can be found on our website. As of 2025-01-01, the data sheet will be updated again, whereby designations and article numbers will be changed in accordance with the further description.

Standardised nomenclature of flanged Gas filters

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-014_Gas-filter-portfolio_1R0. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. From 2025, flanged DUNGS gas filters will follow a new nomenclature. The aim of this new nomenclature is a designation that only contains variable properties. This intends to simplify the designation by dropping superfluous information and to ensure clarity by making the differences clearly visible.

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-014_Gas-filter-portfolio_1R0. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. The products will not undergo any technical changes, only the designation will be changed. The order numbers for the Gas filters won’t change either. The old designations, valid until 2024-12-31, and the new designations, valid from 2025-01-01, are shown in the table below.

2024-10-31 | #014  

The information omitted is the specification of the screw plugs - as each flanged gas filter has four screw plugs - and the indication /3 or /4. The version /4 stands for a slightly different housing variant for nominal sizes DN 50 to DN 100. Since 2009, we have only been selling this housing variant. Therefor this is historical information that is no longer relevant.

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-014_Gas-filter-portfolio_1R0. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. As we have also been offering finer filters with 10 µm in addition to our standard flanged Gas filters with a grade of filtration of 50 µm since last year, we have added the filtration to the designation. This results in the following type code for the flanged Gas filters from 2025:

GF 60 | YYY |/ZZ 1 Gas and air filter Max. operating pressure. E 23 | ggge Il _

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-014_Gas-filter-portfolio_1R0. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. Due to different stock levels, there may be different designations for the gas filters at the beginning of the transition period. DUNGS will deliver the products with the previous designation until the stock is used. As soon as the stocks are empty and newly produced items are delivered, these will contain the updated designation. Regardless of whether the old or new designation is on the product, the products are identical.

2024-10-31 | #014

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-014_Gas-filter-portfolio_1R0. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. Changed order numbers for existing spare parts

The new nomenclature will also be applied to the replacement filter inserts of the flange filters. In future, the Gas filter version of the filter insert will be clearly described. The change will be done to 2025-01-01.

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-014_Gas-filter-portfolio_1R0. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. Additionally, the replacement filter inserts will receive new article numbers. This is due to a change in the packaging process. Contents of the spare parts sets have not changed. Each set contains a filter insert and an O-ring for the corresponding Gas filter. Pictures of the sets are shown in our new data sheet.

Additional spare parts (filtration 10 µm)

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-014_Gas-filter-portfolio_1R0. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. We added flanged Gas filters with a grade of filtration of 10 µm to our product range last year. We have not yet offered replacement filter inserts for 10 µm. From 2025-01-01 we will be adding these spare parts sets to the spare parts list (they are already available). The sets are structured in the same way as the existing ones. This means each set contains a filter insert and an O-ring for the corresponding Gas filter.
